edits.label: add lang+copy
edits.find:
import { HeartPulse, Flame, Activity, Zap, Gauge } from "@lucide/astro";
---

edits.label: translate field+actions
EmptyState+Results
edits.find:
<EmptyState id="emptyState" title="Enter your age to see heart rate zones" description="Your training zones based on max heart rate will appear here." />

    <ResultsGrid id="resultsContainer" hidden>
      <ResultCard id="maxHrResult" title="Max Heart Rate" icon={HeartPulse} accent="primary" size="lg" />
      <ResultCard id="warmUpResult" title="Warm Up (50-60%)" icon={Gauge} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="fatBurnResult" title="Fat Burn (60-70%)" icon={Flame} accent="success" />
      <ResultCard id="cardioResult" title="Cardio (70-80%)" icon={Activity} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="hardcoreResult" title="Hardcore (80-90%)" icon={Zap} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="peakResult" title="Peak (90-100%)" icon={HeartPulse} accent="neutral" />
    </ResultsGrid>
edits.replace:
<EmptyState id="emptyState" title={copy.emptyTitle} description={copy.emptyDesc} />

    <ResultsGrid id="resultsContainer" hidden>
      <ResultCard id="maxHrResult" title={copy.maxHr} icon={HeartPulse} accent="primary" size="lg" />
      <ResultCard id="warmUpResult" title={copy.warmUp} icon={Gauge} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="fatBurnResult" title={copy.fatBurn} icon={Flame} accent="success" />
      <ResultCard id="cardioResult" title={copy.cardio} icon={Activity} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="hardcoreResult" title={copy.hardcore} icon={Zap} accent="neutral" />
      <ResultCard id="peakResult" title={copy.peak} icon={HeartPulse} accent="neutral" />
    </ResultsGrid>

edits.label: wire calcLang
edits.replace:
<script define:vars={{ calcLang: lang }}>
  window.calcLang = calcLang;
</script>
<script>
  import "../../scripts/heartrate-calculator";
</script>
